[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build trigger.manual: get with no trigger (no trigger starts the job, so a person starts it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
